notes: Adds missing schema/contract, API integration, and test coverage stories for full enforcement completeness.

stories.title: Request/Response Validation Schema (Contract Enforcement)
stories.description: Define strict Pydantic schemas for GPTReader request inputs and outputs, including allowed query structure, fields, operators, and enforced defaults. All incoming requests must be validated against schema prior to allowlist logic.

stories.title: Core Allowlist Enforcement Engine
stories.description: Implement the core validation engine that enforces allowlisted collections, fields, operators, and query patterns. Engine must reject any non-compliant request before execution and integrate with config-driven rules.

stories.title: Azure Function API Enforcement Hook
stories.description: Integrate enforcement layer into Azure Function entrypoint so every GPTReader request passes through schema validation, allowlist engine, and guardrails prior to MongoDB execution.

stories.title: Negative and Adversarial Test Suite
stories.description: Develop comprehensive tests covering invalid queries, injection attempts, disallowed fields/operators, oversized payloads, and bypass strategies to ensure enforcement cannot be circumvented.

stories.title: End-to-End Integration with Brain Auth Scope Control
stories.description: Ensure enforcement respects Brain-issued scopes by validating that queries align with token-based access control and scope restrictions before execution.
